title: Development suite (2026-09-15 accuracy cycle) — independently written, for tuning only
description: Phase 2 of the 2026-09-15 accuracy-improvement cycle. Every query here was written fresh for this suite, not copied or lightly reworded from retrieval-100k-v1 — used for tuning ranking behavior (per-pack diversity cap, identifier boosting, alias normalization, fusion weights) so the historical 118-case suite stays a pure, untouched regression check. Covers: CVE/CWE/CAPEC identifiers, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, Active Directory attacks, OAuth/OIDC/SAML, Kubernetes/container security, cloud IAM, malware and capa rules, YARA and Sigma, OWASP LLM risks, incident response, ambiguous terminology, simulated multi-turn follow-ups, and one insufficient-evidence case. KNOWN, DOCUMENTED SCOPE LIMIT: retrieval.retrieve() has no relevance cutoff (established in retrieval-new-domains-v1's own description) — the single insufficient-evidence case here is included to reconfirm that architectural fact at the retrieval layer, not because it is expected to pass; genuine insufficient-evidence behavior is tested at the answer-synthesis layer in tests/test_answer_insufficient_evidence.py. KNOWN GAP: no dedicated SAML source exists anywhere in the enabled corpus (checked: no owasp/rfc/vendor pack covers SAML specifically) — the OAuth/OIDC/SAML category below only has real coverage for OAuth (rfc8252, rfc9700) and OIDC-adjacent identity docs (entra-identity-docs-src); this is reported honestly rather than forcing a SAML expectation against a source that doesn't exist.

cases.query: What does CVE-2021-44228 affect and what is its CVSS severity?

What attack pattern does CAPEC-66 describe for SQL injection?

cases.note: Additively widened 2026-09-15 (same pattern as the already-approved yara-packer case): both packs title their T1055 file identically-length ('T1055 — Process Injection' / 'T1055 - Process Injection'), both are trust_level=official, and both are genuinely, verifiably on-topic (mitre-attack-src = the definitional technique page, atomic-red-team-src = the matching test procedure). Rather than tune the injection tie-break to force one specific pack to win an arbitrary tie between two correct answers, this expectation was widened to accept either.
